description: PGR Atlas at Bedag. Source: pgr-atlas repo, monitoring/grafana/ (README.md there; docs/monitoring.md). The prod copy is generated from the test one.

spec.description: Cores. Seen: 1-2.8 of 4 during a large raster.
spec.title: CPU

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", container="app"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", container="app"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Share of CPU periods in which the container hit its CPU limit. Seen: ~2% during a large raster.
spec.title: CPU throttled

spec.description: The fullest of the pods' PVCs pgr-atlas-spill-pgr-atlas-app-N. Fills during raster jobs and empties afterwards; a level that stays up means leftovers. Seen: peak 64.7 GB on test (v0.1.0, one pod).
spec.title: Spill volume (/tmp)

spec.description: Bytes received by the app pod: almost all of it S3 reads. Seen: ~8 MB/s during a large raster.
spec.title: Network in (S3 through the proxy)

spec.description: Needs Bedag to scrape ingress-nginx. The Ingress's namespace may be in label exported_namespace (used here) or namespace; if the panel is empty, try the other. Since 2026-10 everything goes through pgr-atlas-ingress and the pod's proxy; pgr-atlas-backends only has history.
spec.title: Requests by status

spec.description: Needs Bedag to scrape ingress-nginx. The Ingress's namespace may be in label exported_namespace (used here) or namespace; if the panel is empty, try the other. pgr-atlas-ingress carries everything since 2026-10 (tiles, crops and Streamlit), so Streamlit's hours-long websocket connections are in here too and the tail is theirs; for tiles alone the proxy would need its own metrics.
spec.title: Latency p95, all requests

spec.description: A restart kills running copy jobs; rerunning the same s3m copy continues where it stopped (docs/s3.md). Merging a change to the toolbox replaces the pod: that kills copies as well but doesn't count here.
spec.title: Toolbox restarts in range

spec.expr: sum by (statefulset) (kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{namespace="$namespace", statefulset="pgr-atlas-app"}) / sum by (statefulset) (kube_statefulset_replicas{namespace="$namespace", statefulset="pgr-atlas-app"}) * on (statefulset) group_left (ready) count_values by (statefulset) ("ready", sum by (statefulset) (kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{namespace="$namespace", statefulset="pgr-atlas-app"})) * on (statefulset) group_left (desired) count_values by (statefulset) ("desired", sum by (statefulset) (kube_statefulset_replicas{namespace="$namespace", statefulset="pgr-atlas-app"}))

spec.description: Ready pods of the StatefulSet pgr-atlas-app out of the desired ones, e.g. 2/2 on test, 3/3 on prod (Ready = /readyz: all three servers answer, and the proxy container is up). All ready green, some orange (normal for a few minutes while a deployment replaces the pods one at a time), none red: that is PgrAtlasUnavailable. The text is the query's legend (count_values turns the two numbers into labels); the value behind it is still ready / desired and sets the colour. Which pods: the Running image table.
spec.title: App pods ready

spec.description: Bytes the toolbox pod received in the selected range: roughly what was read from the source (Hosttech via the proxy, or Bedag's S3). Includes protocol overhead.
spec.title: Received in range

spec.description: Bytes the toolbox pod sent in the selected range: roughly what was written to the target bucket. Includes protocol overhead.
spec.title: Sent in range

spec.description: Network of the toolbox pod. During a copy, in and out run roughly level: rclone streams S3 to S3 without touching the disk.
spec.title: Copy throughput

spec.description: rclone buffers per transfer; many parallel transfers of big files push this toward the 2 GiB limit (OOM kills the copy).
spec.title: Toolbox memory

spec.description: Cores. TLS and checksums cost CPU; at the limit the copy slows down rather than fails.
spec.title: Toolbox CPU

spec.description: Container restarts within the selected time range. Reason: 'Last termination' table.
spec.title: Restarts in range

spec.description: Working set / memory limit, now. Alert PgrAtlasMemoryHigh at 90% for 10 min.
spec.title: Memory of limit

spec.description: /tmp of the fullest pod: each pod has its own PVC pgr-atlas-spill-pgr-atlas-app-N (DuckDB spill + raster work DB). DuckDB stops at PROBE_DUCKDB_MAX_TEMP_SIZE (~90%). Alert at 85% for 30 min, per claim.
spec.title: Spill volume used

spec.description: Image of the app container, from cAdvisor's image label (Bedag's metrics don't include kube_pod_container_info). Should match tag: in deploy/stages/<stage>/pgr-atlas/values.yaml.
spec.title: Running image

spec.description: Why the app container last stopped (OOMKilled, Error, Completed). Empty if it never restarted, or if Bedag's metrics don't include kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason (not verified yet).
spec.title: Last termination

spec.description: Working set is what the OOM killer counts. Seen: ~5 GiB during a large raster, peak 6.6 GiB of 8.
spec.title: Memory
